guides.title: 師傅導讀：分清煙氣、鍋爐水與做功蒸汽
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Separate combustion gas, boiler water and working steam
guides.concept: 蒸汽機車看似一個大型鍋爐，實際上至少有三條不同流路。煙氣把熱傳給水，產生的蒸汽進入汽缸做功，再經排汽系統離開。輪子轉動來自壓力差與連桿機構，而不是煙直接推動車輪。
guides.conceptEn: A steam locomotive contains distinct gas, water and steam paths. Combustion gases transfer heat to water; steam then expands in cylinders and exhausts. Pressure differences and mechanical linkages turn the wheels, rather than smoke driving them directly.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 蒸汽原理解說，以三種線型自繪煙氣、給水與蒸汽流路，交會處僅代表換熱時不得畫成流體混合。
把熱量傳入、汽缸做功與機械傳動分成三段，為每段列出輸入與輸出。
在不加壓的紙上模型中，畫出活塞前後兩端壓力不同時的受力方向；再連到連桿與曲柄。
依博物館剖面解說，指出圖上看不到或尚未查證的部件，將它們列為待查而不是補造配置。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS explanation and draw gas, feedwater and steam routes with different line styles. Do not show fluid mixing where only heat transfer occurs.
Separate heat input, cylinder work and mechanical transmission. List the input and output of each.
In an unpressurised paper model, draw the force direction caused by different pressures across a piston and connect it to the rod and crank.
Use the museum cutaway explanation to identify missing or unverified components. Mark them for research instead of inventing an arrangement.
evidence: 三條不混淆的流路示意。
能量轉換與損失位置的標註。
能用自己的話說明鍋爐、汽缸與連桿各自的作用。
evidenceEn: A schematic with three distinct fluid paths.
Annotations locating energy conversions and losses.
An independent explanation of the boiler, cylinder and connecting-rod roles.
pitfalls: 把火管內煙氣與管外水混成一條路徑。
把高壓當成無限能量來源而忽略熱輸入。
將博物館原理介紹當成壓力容器製造或點火程序。
pitfallsEn: Merging gases inside fire tubes with water outside them.
Treating pressure as unlimited energy without heat input.
Using museum interpretation as pressure-vessel fabrication or firing instructions.
guides.sourceNote: 依官方來源的工程原理原創編寫之學習活動；示例與驗收證據是學習要求，並非業主施工計畫、現場試驗資料或本網站已提供的量測資料。
guides.sourceNoteEn: Original learning activities based on principles in official sources. Examples and evidence are learning requirements, not an owner-approved method statement, field test data, or measurement datasets supplied by this website.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從駕駛室儀表建立機械狀態判讀
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Read mechanical state through cab instruments
guides.concept: 儀表顯示的量、閥件改變的量與機器真正的反應不一定相同。駕駛室導覽可以用來練習「控制—量測—回應」對照；Big Boy 4012 的靜態展示也提醒我們，外觀完整不等於已具備動態運轉資格。
guides.conceptEn: An indicated quantity, a valve’s commanded change and the machine’s response are different kinds of evidence. Use the cab tour to map control, measurement and response. Big Boy 4012’s static display also distinguishes appearance from operational readiness.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 駕駛室導覽，把確認名稱的儀表與控制件列成表；聽不清楚的項目保留待查。
每列寫下它量測或控制的物理量、操作者希望知道的狀態，以及還需要哪些獨立觀察。
設計一個純紙上案例：指示值不動，但其他相關跡象改變；提出儀表失靈與系統狀態不變兩個假說，避免先指定原因。
比較 NPS 對靜態展示與完成運轉整修機車的說明，整理外觀修復、功能檢查與運轉驗證屬於不同證據層級。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS cab tour and tabulate instruments and controls whose names you can verify. Leave uncertain items unresolved.
For each, state the physical quantity, the condition the crew needs to infer and any independent observation required.
Create a paper case where one indication stays fixed while related signs change. Compare a faulty instrument with an unchanged process as competing hypotheses.
Compare NPS descriptions of static display and operational overhaul. Separate cosmetic restoration, functional checks and operating validation as distinct evidence levels.
evidence: 含已確認與待查項目的儀表功能表。
一項指示異常的兩個假說及區分方法。
說明為何看見閥件或輪子就不能判定機車可投入運轉。
evidenceEn: An instrument-function table separating verified and unresolved items.
Two hypotheses and discriminating evidence for an anomalous indication.
An explanation of why visible controls or wheels do not establish operating readiness.
pitfalls: 認為所有機車的閥件配置與操作邏輯相同。
把儀表讀值直接視為完整機械狀態。
忽略靜態展車與動態運轉機車的不同驗證要求。
pitfallsEn: Assuming all locomotives share the same valve arrangement and operating logic.
Treating one indication as the full mechanical state.
Ignoring the different evidence required for static display and operation.
guides.sourceNote: 依官方來源的工程原理原創編寫之學習活動；示例與驗收證據是學習要求，並非業主施工計畫、現場試驗資料或本網站已提供的量測資料。
guides.sourceNoteEn: Original learning activities based on principles in official sources. Examples and evidence are learning requirements, not an owner-approved method statement, field test data, or measurement datasets supplied by this website.

courses.summary: 約克的國家鐵路博物館讓蒸汽機車從退役設備變成可持續研究的工程證據。以Mallard與A4系列為一個具體入口，可以把熱機、車輪連桿、車體外形與鐵路系統放在一起觀察；它只是眾多蒸汽機車設計中的一支，不能代表所有年代與國家的製造方法。
courses.summaryEn: York’s National Railway Museum turns retired railway equipment into enduring engineering evidence. Mallard and the A4 family provide a concrete entry point for observing heat engines, wheel linkages, body form and the railway system together. They represent one design family, not the manufacturing methods of every period or country.

history.title: Mallard的速度紀錄
history.text: 1938年7月3日，Mallard達到每小時126英里的蒸汽機車速度紀錄。課程不把紀錄視為日常運行條件，而是請學徒分辨單次試驗成果、日常服務與維修負擔這三種不同問題。
history.textEn: On 3 July 1938, Mallard reached a steam-locomotive speed record of 126 mph. The course treats this as a record run rather than a routine operating condition, inviting learners to distinguish a test achievement, everyday service and maintenance burden.

history.title: 舊車庫成為公共博物館
history.titleEn: A former depot becomes a public museum
history.text: 國家鐵路博物館於1975年在約克開館，利用舊有動力車庫轉作展示空間。工程故事因此多了一層：保存機車也需要建築再利用、展品支承與知識整理。
history.textEn: The National Railway Museum opened in York in 1975, adapting a former motive-power depot for display. This adds another engineering layer: preserving locomotives also involves building reuse, exhibit support and the organization of knowledge.

history.title: 六輛存世A4機車相聚
history.text: 為紀念Mallard紀錄75週年，六輛存世A4機車於2013年在約克相聚。並置觀察提供一個學習方法：同一設計家族的外觀相似，不表示每輛車的使用經歷與保存狀態相同。
history.textEn: For the record’s 75th anniversary, all six surviving A4 locomotives gathered in York in 2013. Side-by-side observation offers a learning method: similar appearance within a design family does not imply identical service histories or conservation condition.

courses.connection: 蒸汽機車能連到鐵路橋梁、路基、車站與給水設施：車輛再強，也必須與軌道承載、轉彎及服務設施共同工作。可用縮尺示意模型比較蒸汽與電力牽引的能量流，再討論歷史車庫改作博物館時的結構與保存需求；不進行實體鍋爐製造或加壓實驗。
courses.connectionEn: Steam locomotives connect naturally to railway bridges, track foundations, stations and water facilities: a vehicle works within track-load, curve and servicing constraints. Use a scale schematic to compare steam and electric traction energy flows, then discuss structural and conservation needs when adapting a historic depot into a museum. No physical boiler construction or pressurization experiment is involved.
